attractions.name: Isle of Skye Day Tour
attractions.description: Full-day guided minivan tour from Inverness via Eilean Donan Castle (photo stop) and Skye Bridge to Portree (lunch stop), with Old Man of Storr, Kilt Rock and Quiraing
tips: Meeting point at 19 Union Street, Inverness; arrive 15 minutes early
Bring layers, water, light snacks, a power bank and a camera

attractions.name: Quiraing
attractions.description: Dramatic landscape with rolling moors and stunning views
